## Intent
Outcome, acceptance, non-goals and boundaries (link existing authority; no mirror spec).
For gameplay, name the capability and applicable game/character profile.

## Change and proof
Affected paths; exact base/head; commands/results; deliberate omissions.
For learning changes: source/frame provenance, candidate versus promoted status,
held-out evidence and the actual runtime consumer. Do not equate replay with live play.

## Four-rule balance
What removes wall time/token cost, and what proves no acceptance was dropped?
State actual controller/model/knowledge versions when behaviour is compared.

## Effects and recovery
Live authority: none unless a bounded run envelope is linked. State tested mode,
stop/takeover, last accepted version, rollback and remaining runtime gaps.

The exact-head review is a GitHub review, not a checkbox in this description.
